summary: Stability updates for the release process, ensuring more reliable future version releases.

items.text: Fixed authentication configuration for the auto-release flow, reducing release failure risks.

summary: Kairos begins supporting more complete public sharing and multi-language experiences.

items.text: Added Plaza capabilities, providing more complete public content display.
Added Chinese and English localization support for natural interface language switching.
Merged multiple security and interaction enhancements for overall stability.

summary: Focused on engineering reliability, improving online stability and maintainability.

items.text: Introduced Error Boundaries to gracefully catch page exceptions.
Supplemented testing and data validation chains to reduce regression issues.

summary: Enhanced cross-platform experience, supporting offline capabilities and batch processing scenes.

items.text: Support for Chinese and English bilingual support.
PWA support, can be used as an app-like experience.
Added data export and batch operations for higher management efficiency.

summary: Enhanced security protection and request validation capabilities.

items.text: Added rate limiting, JWT revocation, and input validation mechanisms.
Fixed middleware conflicts for a more stable access flow.

summary: Performance-oriented update, improving data access and response speeds.

items.text: Added database indexes and Redis caching logic.

summary: Formal establishment of the testing system for more controllable version quality.

items.text: Introduced Vitest and Playwright automated testing frameworks.
Fixed semantic-release permissions and fetch depth configurations.

summary: First complete milestone of Kairos, covering records, search, import, plaza, and theme systems.

items.text: Launched Goodreads import, Spotify music search, multi-user timelines, and public plaza.
Supports Light/Dark/System themes, refined entry and editing experience.
Enhanced search robustness and observability, sorted by latest update by default.
Fixed critical stability issues such as heatmaps, login redirection, and long content scrolling.
Supports auto-migration on startup and version check capabilities, reducing deployment and maintenance costs.
